decisions.reason: Because submarine interior lighting is relatively far from the firm's core lighting knowledge base and was only lightly presented, management is likely to see limited absorptive capacity and weak early evidence for further commitment.
A medical examination light builds on the firm's established lighting capabilities and in-house R&D, so the firm is well placed to learn from early market feedback and refine the product.

Explosion-proof industrial luminaires fit closely with the firm's industrial customer base, engineering strengths and certification-oriented development capabilities, making continued commercialization attractive.
The designer task light is close to the existing offer and was relaunched as a popular product, so the firm has strong prior knowledge and little reason to withdraw it quickly.
